Before me stands #C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF's barrier――
The Core of this Labyrinth.
We need to get rid of it in order to proceed.
No. Our greatest hurdle awaits us afterwards.

#C236196003BB#CDEF is trying to invade the #C000246204Moon Cell's Core#CDEF
and become the #C000246204Moon Cell#CDEF itself.
If we don't stop her, humanity will be met with a slow death.

Failure is not an option.
No matter what it takes, #C236196003BB#CDEF must be――

Hrm. Wait, #RUBS  Master#RUBEPraetor#REND.
Take a deep breath and relax for a moment.
I can see the strain all over your face.

Just act as you always do
and promise to rely on me more.

As a bonus, you also have #C236196003Rin#CDEF, #C236196003Rani#CDEF,
and #C236196003Sakura#CDEF with you. Even if you're scared,
there's no need to worry, now is there?

Listen, your shoulders are beyond tense.
If you don't relax, you'll turn the odds
of battle against us.

I'm proud to see you take this situation so
responsibly, but your earnestness will
bury you sooner or later.

Take a deep breath.
Think about everyone who has your back.
There's no reason to carry things alone.

Oh, Darling! You look astoundingly gallant
with all that determinated sweat on your brow,
but might I suggest a quick refresh?

Ready? Breathe in, breathe out, breathe in.
How do you feel? More relaxed now, Master?

Fool. What are you getting so fixated
in that head of yours?

Are insecurities rearing their ugly heads again?
If you can't change everything, show some
discretion for whatever it is you fret over.

Don't forget who you came all this way with.
I might dwell on the burdens you put me through,
but such arrogance is MY right――not yours.

Lest you mean to insult those who've fought
by your side so far, turn to your comrades
when something worries you.

I got pretty pent up, but I'm not alone here.
Even if I were to make a mistake,
my dependable comrades have my back.

I'll make sure you aren't swallowed by
#C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF's consciousness, alright?
I'll get you back in one piece!

If I enforced copyright on this stuff back on
Earth, I'd make a fortune. But I'm here giving
quality work for free. I'm losing my touch.

That said, the thought of leaving you to
fight all on your own does bother me.

Let's end this with a nice, clean slate
and get back to the #C000246204Holy Grail War#CDEF!

I'm putting more effort into this dive
than I ever have before as well.

There's no logic to apply to how I'm feeling.
I never expected I'd feel such an aspiration,
but I want to put in more than my 100%.

Now then. I wish you good fortune in battle,
#[Mr.][Ms.]##C236196003 #NICK#CDEF――at some point, we'll
settle things back in the #C000246204Holy Grail War#CDEF.
The sounds of their voices make me smile.

The #C000246204Holy Grail War#CDEF.
There was a point in time in which
every day was a struggle for survival.

Between the days I spent here in the Far Side
and the days I spent in those battles…

I tried to discern which was more bizarre,
and I ended up with an uncanny smile on my face.

I'm pretty sure I heard once that humanity's
greatest weapon was our adaptability.

It's true.
To me, even these days of fighting to find
my heart have turned out to be meaningful.
…and these days will soon come to a close.

Regardless of the outcome, the end is near.
Looks like I've eased up enough to
feel reluctant about leaving this all behind.

Oh, bother. I bet that girl's so insecure about

You can't just throw it all out there!
True #RUBS     eros #RUBEsex appeal#REND is amplified when it's hidden!

Is that all the appeal

Still, you don't intend on drowning in
that nectar, right? Listen.
Don't falter in your preparation.

As much as I'd like to enter the Relief now,
I'll need #C236196003Rin#CDEF's help in order to do so.

Let's head back to the #C000246204Student Council Room#CDEF

It's time to finish things with #C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF―― and then #C236196003BB#CDEF!
I hear #C236196003Sakura#CDEF's voice through the comms.

It's a private circuit through which
neither #C236196003Rin#CDEF nor #C236196003Rani#CDEF can hear.

Oh, it's nothing. Sorry, I'm becoming more
faint-hearted. I wanted to hear your voice one
more time――what's the matter with me?

That's all I had to say, I promise.
Please don't show pity to
anything that was spawned from #C236196003BB#CDEF.
She rejects those two, but also fears for them.

She doesn't want to approve of those two learning
a humane sense of love――is what it sounds like to me.

I agree with #C236196003Sakura#CDEF.
#C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF won't listen to what we have to say.
She's an immutable #C000246204Alter Ego#CDEF.

She won't be swayed by the values of another,
meaning she'll probably never be reformed.
Not until she feels ashamed of herself.

Let's use our power of love to show everyone the
difference between "a world for two people"
versus "a world with only two people in it"!

I don't care either way.
#C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF is merely a means to an end.
It's the mastermind's head I want.

Sorry for bringing this up before the fight.
I'll end the transmission, okay?

#C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF's obtrusive wall is now gone.
Before us lies an uncharted path,
the ends of which I cannot see.

Student Council communications have cut out.
#C236196003Sakura#CDEF was being taken over,
but I hope she's alright now.

We defeated her True Self.
The Melt Virus should've been eradicated.
More importantly――

I think #C236196003Sakura#CDEF is fine.
I'm sure your victory saved her, Darling.
Putting that matter aside――

The parent body doing the assimilating is gone.
Naturally, this may have ceased the takeover.
More importantly――
#C236196003#SVT#CDEF looks towards the stairs leading to the Core.
―――That's right. This battle isn't over yet.

Usually we would return to the old school building,
but we're in a race against time.
Let's continue down the stairs.

We need to enter the #C000246204Core#CDEF before #C236196003BB#CDEF
breaks through the barrier―――!
